ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Macro-level ratio of approximately 75% high-intensity (white) pixels to 25% low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white pixels dominate the central regions. Low-intensity black pixels form a continuous band along the trailing edge and medial notch. A distinct, isolated low-intensity circular blob is located in the upper-left quadrant of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped depression with a pixel angle of approximately 65 degrees and a bounding-box depth equivalent to roughly 15% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serrations with pixel-amplitudes varying between 5-20 pixels; a deep singular notch is visible on the distal third of the right lobe trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge lobes exhibit a convex curve transitioning to a neutral/straight trajectory at the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed clusters of high-contrast, textured pixels (rosette patterns) localized at the distal tips of both fluke lobes, corresponding to barnacle attachment points.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) varying in length and orientation across the central white portions of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable parallel rake marks on the right lobe and significant jagged tissue irregularity at the distal extremities suggestive of repeated barnacle colonization.
other_distinctive_markers: A singular, high-contrast black circular spot located on the upper-left section of the left fluke lobe.
